areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Safe housing, public spaces and urban mobility components with direct links, roughly half of resources, indicators and targets; high impact and efficient solutions.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Recovery of water bodies, linear parks and botanical garden with water-quality indicators; small resource share and target public, so moderate impact.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Slope stabilization, risk-area recovery and macrodrainage with an indicator on flooding hotspots; high impact but a small resource share.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: Industrial, agro-food and market infrastructure with a job-creation indicator; moderate impact given resources and target public; efficient solutions.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Objective and products on job generation and productive insertion, but no resources specifically allocated and efficiency not demonstrated.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Institutional strengthening component (administrative modernization, integrated management systems, training) with satisfaction indicator; high impact, efficient solutions.
